feat: Implementation of the full functionality of chat and message management
- Added endpoints for managing chats: * PATCH /api/chats/{chat_id}/rename to change the chat name * DELETE /api/chats/{chat_id} to delete a chat
- Implemented work with messages: * POST /api/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages for sending messages * GET /api/conversations/{conversation_id} for restoring message history
- Fixed the implementation of functions in SQLITEAlchemy: * update_chat_title: correct chat search by chat_id * delete_chat: check whether the chat belongs to the user * add_new_message: saving messages to the database * get_chat_messages: getting the message history from the database
- Database models updated: * The chat_id field type in the Messages model has been fixed from BigInteger to String(36) * Consistency of data types for foreign keys has been ensured * The existing one-to-many relationship between users and chats
has been maintained - Migrations have been applied to transfer IDs to UUID7: * bc73427871e2 - updating the chat_id column in the users table * 148a39e82c80 - updating the chat_id and user_id columns in the chats table
